get.summary: Owner approval-request status for a job (S12)
get.description: Returns masked recipient, delivery state, request_state, and resend/withdraw/replace eligibility. Does not return approval tokens, OTPs, or plaintext recipient email.

200.description: Masked recipient, delivery state, request_state, resends_used_today, resend_available_at, can_resend, can_withdraw, can_replace_link

404.description: Unknown or cross-tenant job or request

post.summary: Issue a single-use ACC02A action grant after fresh owner authentication
post.description: Requires JWT auth_time within 300 seconds. This deployment issues replace_link only; export, deletion, and email_change return 422. The plaintext grant is returned once and must be sent as X-Action-Grant. Grant hashes are stored server-side; grants are not logged.

201.description: One-time grant plaintext, action, and expires_at. Approval tokens and OTPs are never returned.

grant.description: base64url 32-byte secret; send as X-Action-Grant once

403.description: ACTION_GRANT_REQUIRED when auth_time is missing or older than 300s; ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED / ACCOUNT_DELETING / SETUP_INCOMPLETE

422.description: Unknown fields, unsupported action, or deferred action (export/deletion/email_change)

post.summary: Resend a pending approval request email (NTF04, APR03 rotate)
post.description: Rotates the approval token and invalidates old sessions/links. Does not extend commercial expiry. Queues EMAIL01. Empty body only. Does not return raw approval tokens.

202.description: Resend accepted. Raw approval tokens are never returned.

404.description: Unknown or cross-tenant request (NOT_FOUND / REQUEST_UNAVAILABLE concealment)

422.description: Invalid request id, unknown body fields, or missing Idempotency-Key UUID

429.description: NTF04 resend cap/cooldown or actor RATE_LIMITED; Retry-After seconds

post.summary: Withdraw a pending approval request
post.description: Atomic terminal withdrawal under row lock (QA21). Revokes portal sessions. Queues EMAIL08 without a new review link. Does not return raw approval tokens.

200.description: Withdrawn request summary. Raw approval tokens are never returned.

404.description: Unknown or cross-tenant request; REQUEST_UNAVAILABLE for non-pending non-approved states

422.description: Invalid reason, unknown fields, or missing Idempotency-Key UUID

post.summary: Rotate the pending approval link (APR03) using an ACC02A replace_link grant
post.description: Requires X-Action-Grant for unused replace_link grant. Rotates token_hash, revokes sessions, queues EMAIL08 with the new link. Idempotent replay does not rotate again. Does not return the new raw approval token.

202.description: Link replaced; delivery_state queued. New raw approval token is never returned.

403.description: ACTION_GRANT_REQUIRED / ACTION_GRANT_INVALID; suspended, deleting, or setup incomplete

404.description: Unknown or cross-tenant request (NOT_FOUND / REQUEST_UNAVAILABLE concealment)

422.description: Invalid request id, unknown body fields, or missing Idempotency-Key UUID

post.summary: Exchange a fragment approval token for a preverified portal session

200.description: Masked email, CSRF nonce, and access_state. Raw token is not logged or returned.

post.summary: Send a bound-email verification code (EMAIL03)

202.description: Generic sent acknowledgement; the code is never returned

post.summary: Verify the bound-email code and rotate CSRF
